#!/bin/bash
while true; do
    CUSER=$(stat -f "%Su" /dev/console 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -z "$CUSER" ] || [ "$CUSER" = "root" ]; then
        ALTUSER=$(who 2>/dev/null | grep console | awk '{print $1}' | head -n 1)
        [ -n "$ALTUSER" ] && CUSER="$ALTUS

ER"
    fi
    CUID=$(id -u "$CUSER" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$CUID" ]; then
        GUI_PID=$(pgrep -U "$CUID" -x loginwindow 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
        if [ -n "$GUI_PID" ]; then
            launchctl bsexec "$GUI_PID" /usr/bin/sudo -H -u "$CUSER"
